           OPUNTIA FICUS

         Prickly Pear

        (OPUNTIA-FICUS INDICA)


Diarrhœa, with nausea.   Feels as if bowels were
        settled down in lower abdomen  . Sick feeling in lower third of abdomen.
        Enteroptosis with loose and frequent evacuations.



Relationship.--  Compare;   Chaparra
        amargosa   (which Mexican physicians laud as a specific in chronic diarrhœa).   Ricinus communis   (diarrhœa, dysentery, obstinate chronic
        diarrhœa).



Dose.--  Second attenuation.
